item.title: [ECG] HOP December 2026 Camp
item.description: Dear students, Are you interested in working in the healthcare sector? Is your dream career to be a nurse or a pharmacist? Or perhaps, have you always aspired to become a doctor or an allied health professional, but you are unsure of what it entails? Well, fret not! This year, students from NUS Medicine Nursing, Pharmacy, Dentistry and SIT Nursing, Diagnostic Radiography, Radiation Therapy, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech and Language Therapy, Dietetics and Nutrition are collaborating to bring you the Healthcare Outreach Project (HOP) December Camp 2026! Details of the event are as follows: HOP December 2026 Camp Venue: National University of Singapore (NUS) *Date and Time: 14 Dec (8:15am - 7:30pm) 15 Dec (9:30am - 7:00pm) 16 Dec (8:30am - 6:45pm) Cost: $35 (inclusive of catered lunch & camp shirt) *Durations of the event are tentative, and more details will be confirmed at a later date. HOP 2026 December Camp is a 3-day programme seeking to provide you with a broader perspective of the different healthcare courses and careers available in Singapore through sharing sessions by university students and professionals in the field. Fun and informative activities are also specially planned by students from the respective faculties, aiming to give you a better knowledge of the different healthcare professions, enabling you to make an informed decision prior to choosing the healthcare course you wish to study in the future. Want to sign up? You may sign up via the link here: https://forms.gle/A1annQZqbxTRFC3YA Our signups are open from now till 30 October 2026, 2359 hrs To find out more about HOP or get updates about our upcoming events, please visit our social media platforms: Instagram: @healthcareoutreachproject Website: https://healthcareoutreachproject.com Telegram channel: HOP Telegram Channel For any enquiries, feel free to drop us an email at nus.hop.main@gmail.com . We hope to see you at HOP 2026! Thank you!
